name: apply_unified_patch

test_list.description: Apply a valid hunk only when every context and deletion line matches the base.
Reject malformed ranges and mismatched context without modifying source bytes.
Preserve base line-ending style and final-newline state in derived bytes.
Store proposal bytes in real CAS before submitting CommandBody::ProposeDiff; never write target files.

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: Current source bytes read from the workspace.

inputs.name: patch
inputs.description: Unified patch text supplied by the model.

output_description: The derived content bytes only; persistence and command submission are a separate injected proposal operation.
